0:
Choose between 2 rule sets:
Pro Wrestling Rules and Mixed
Martial Arts Rules.

　　@BPro Wrestling Rules: the standard
　　All Japan Pro Wrestling rules.
　　@BMixed Martial Arts Rules: a strict,
　　shoot-style set with a lost-point
　　system and knockdowns.@D
1:
Sets the time limit for the match.
Choose from 13 options: 5, 10, 15, 20,
25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60 Min.
and No Limit.
10:
Sets whether other wrestlers run in
during the match. Choose Yes or No.

Usually the wrestler set as the
@BRival Wrestler@D in each wrestler's
parameters is the one most likely
to run in.
11:
Sets whether the title changes hands
on a countout. Choose Yes or No.

This can only be set for matches
with a title on the line.
12:
Sets the match time. Choose from
8 options: 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30,
60 Min. and No Limit.

Under Mixed Martial Arts Rules,
this is the length of 1 round.
13:
Sets how many rounds the match
lasts. Choose from 10 options:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 10, 12, 15 Rounds,
and No.
14:
Sets the points each wrestler
starts with. Choose from 5 options:
3, 5, 10, 15 Pt. and Free.

In a points match, the side whose
points hit 0 loses by TKO on the spot.
15:
Sets whether points are lost for
escaping to the ropes. Choose from
5 options: 1, 2, 3 Pt., Free, No.

Set @BFree@D for no point loss, or
@BNo@D to remove rope escapes entirely.
@Y(Note)@D
　　Under @BMixed Martial Arts Rules@D,
　　escape to the ropes by pressing
　　$6$7$8$9 near the ropes.
16:
Sets whether points are lost when a
KO causes a knockdown. Choose from
5 options: 1, 2, 3 Pt., Free, No.

Set @BFree@D for no point loss, or
@BNo@D to remove knockdowns entirely.
17:
Sets whether points are lost when a
suplex (throw) lands. Choose from
4 options: 1, 2, 3 Pt. and Free.

Set @BFree@D for no point loss.
18:
Sets whether Quick Match is in
effect. Choose Yes or No.

@BQuick Match@D means submissions and
TKOs have a high chance of finishing
the match early on, regardless of
damage.

Set to @BYes@D for tense, shoot-style
matches: @Yget them before they get
you!@D
19:
Sets whether the knockdown count
continues if the round ends during
it. Choose Yes or No.
2:
Sets the rules for fighting outside
the ring. Choose from 5 options:
10 Counts, 20 Counts, Lumberjack,
No DQ, and No.

@BLumberjack@D means wrestlers cannot
leave the ring.
@BNo DQ@D means falls and submissions
count outside the ring, just as they
do inside it.
20:
Sets whether a referee's decision
is used when time runs out.
Choose Yes or No.

Under Mixed Martial Arts Rules, the
side with the most @Bremaining points@D
wins. Otherwise, or on a tie, the
decision is based first on @Bremaining
health@D, then on @Bhits landed@D.
21:
Sets how long a wrestler without
the tag can stay in the ring, e.g.
for a tag. Choose from 8 options:
5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 Sec. and
No Tag Format.

@BNo Tag Format@D means both members
of a team are legal at the same time,
with no tagging.
22:
Sets the rules for fighting outside
the ring. Choose from 3 options:
Lose, No DQ, and No.

@BLose@D means merely falling outside
the ring is a loss by disqualification.
@BNo DQ@D means falls and submissions
count outside the ring, just as they
do inside it.
23:
Sets the computer's strength.
Choose from 5 options: Beginner,
Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert.

@Y(Royal Road Succession Note)@D
　　In @BRoyal Road Succession@D, strength
　　varies by rank to give each wrestler
　　personality. It does not mean a fixed
　　difficulty as in @BExhibition and other
　　modes@D.
24:
Sets whether the Spirit meter is
shown during matches. Choose
Yes or No.

@Y(Note)@D
　　With the display set to @GNo@D, the
　　Hybrid Wrestling strike meter is
　　also hidden.
25:
Sets whether a referee is shown
during matches. Choose from 3
options: No, Kyohei Wada, Dandy K.

@Y(Note)@D
　　The referee only appears in
　　singles matches.
26:
Sets whether a powerful move
triggers a replay from 3 quick
camera angles. Choose Yes or No.
27:
Sets the in-match display to color
or black-and-white (monochrome).
Choose Color or Black & White.
28:
Sets the sound output type.
Choose Stereo or Mono.
29:
Selects the BGM played during
matches. Choose from 6 tracks.

Choose @BNo@D for no BGM during
matches. Choose @BRandom@D and the
computer picks 1 of the 6 tracks.
3:
Sets whether pinfalls can win the
match. Choose Yes or No.

Set to @BNo@D and matches cannot be
won by pinfall.
30:
Sets the volume of the BGM played
during matches. Choose Low,
Medium, or High.
31:
Sets whether a referee is shown
during matches. Choose from 4
options: No, Kyohei Wada, Dandy K,
@YJohnny H@D.

@Y(Note)@D
　　The referee only appears in
　　singles matches.
4:
Sets whether submissions can win
the match. Choose Yes or No.

Set to @BNo@D and matches cannot be
won by submission.
5:
Sets whether TKOs can win the
match. Choose Yes or No.

Set to @BNo@D and matches cannot be
won by TKO.

Which moves can score a KO is set
per move, but you can set your own
in @YEdit@D mode.
6:
Sets whether rope breaks are in
effect. Choose Yes or No.

Set to @BNo@D and reaching the ropes
will no longer stop a pin or
submission.
7:
Sets whether Quick Match is in
effect. Choose Yes or No.

@BQuick Match@D means pins, submissions
and TKOs have a high chance of
finishing the match early on,
regardless of damage.
Set to @BYes@D for tense, shoot-style
matches: @Yget them before they get
you!@D
8:
Sets whether wrestlers bleed during
the match. Choose Yes, First Blood,
or No.

@BFirst Blood@D means the first wrestler
to bleed is judged unable to continue
and loses: a severe, shoot-style rule.
9:
Sets whether a referee's decision
is used when time runs out.
Choose Yes or No.

The decision is based first on
@Bremaining health@D, then on @Bhits
landed@D on the opponent. The higher
total wins.
